items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: I had the reed section open with him, just the opening number, one number. Then they'd disappear and he'd have it with the rhythm section.

ctx.x: And he had a dance team with a little fellow they called Van. And they got -- was getting a song together and they were dancers. And Van deceased. But they came to my house at 3:00 at night, and said, man, we got a song here, listen.

And I got up out of the bed and went down on the riverbank, and didn't have any manuscript paper. So I took some plain writing paper and made some lines and went down and sat on the riverbank and let them sing it. And I remember all the other words that they had, she had to correct. And they had lyrics in there, like I worked for you, I slaved by
